Subject: Intro & short demo — follow-up from 'Scaling LLMs for Finance' session

Hi Jamie —

Thanks for registering for our ‘Scaling LLMs for Finance’ panel yesterday — glad you could join. A few registrants asked for a short product walkthrough focused on inference cost and latency controls for sensitive financial workloads; I wanted to follow up to offer a tailored 30-minute demo next week.

Quick agenda I propose (30 mins):
- 5m intro + context on your workload
- 15m focused demo: dedicated vs hosted routing, caching, quantization tradeoffs
- 10m Q&A + next steps (pilot/POC planning)

Are any of these windows good for you (I’m in PDT but writing times in ET to reduce back-and-forth):
- Tue Aug 3 — 10:00–10:30 AM ET
- Tue Aug 3 — 2:00–2:30 PM ET
- Wed Aug 4 — 11:00–11:30 AM ET

If none work, tell me two slots that suit you and I’ll loop in Ben (solutions engineer) with a calendar invite. I’ve attached a short mutual action plan so you can see typical milestones for a pilot.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Sales Development Representative | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192
